title: The 10 Best Bluetooth Speakers Under $100
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for bluetooth speakers under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at bluetooth speakers under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: JBL Flip 6 Portable Bluetooth Speaker
products.blurb: Key specs: IP67 dust and water resistance, 12-hour battery life, Racetrack driver with dedicated tweeter.
strengths: Dedicated tweeter gives noticeably clearer highs than cheaper JBL models
Fits in a water bottle pocket at 1.2 pounds
IP67 handles pool, rain, and dusty trail conditions
PartyBoost pairing adds a second speaker for stereo or louder mono output
Sounds tighter and less distorted at high volume than the Flip 5 it replaced
limitations: 12-hour battery is short next to the Charge 5's 20 hours
No phone-charging output
Bass can overpower mids at 80 percent volume and above
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Anker Soundcore 3 Bluetooth Speaker
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual 16-watt drivers, BassUp DSP bass enhancement, 24-hour battery life.
strengths: Dual 16-watt drivers push more low end than any speaker this size and price should manage
24-hour battery is the longest of any speaker under 50 dollars
Soundcore app adds custom EQ and firmware updates most budget speakers lack
Fabric wrap has proven durable across thousands of owner reports
At roughly 40 dollars, best sound-per-dollar in the entire under-100 field
limitations: IPX7 only, no dust rating for sandy environments
Plastic build feels less premium than JBL or Marshall
No multi-speaker pairing beyond basic stereo linking
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Anker Soundcore Motion Boom Bluetooth Speaker
products.blurb: Key specs: IPX7 water resistance, 24-hour battery life, Titanium driver housing.
strengths: Titanium driver delivers clarity that competes with speakers twice the price
BassUp mode matches the JBL Flip 6's low-end depth at a lower cost
24-hour battery ties for the longest in this price range
Outdoor-tuned EQ genuinely boosts vocals and treble in open air
limitations: IPX7 only, no dust protection
Bulkier and less pocketable than cylinder-style speakers
App and ecosystem features trail JBL and Anker's own Soundcore 3

products.name: JBL Go 3 Portable Bluetooth Speaker
products.blurb: Key specs: IP67 dust and water resistance, 7.6-ounce pocket-sized build, 5-hour battery life.
strengths: Smallest and lightest speaker in this list at 7.6 ounces
IP67 handles the pool, shower, and beach without concern
Clear, pleasant sound at close range for desk or nightstand use
limitations: 5-hour battery is the shortest on this list
Limited bass depth from its small single driver
Not loud enough to fill a room or outdoor space

products.name: Sony SRS-XB13 Extra Bass Bluetooth Speaker
products.blurb: Key specs: IP67 dust and water resistance, Extra Bass tuning, 16-hour battery life.
strengths: Extra Bass tuning adds surprising low-end for a palm-sized speaker
16-hour battery beats most speakers in its price bracket
IP67 rating matches speakers costing twice as much
Built-in strap makes it easy to hang or carry
limitations: Bass-forward tuning suits hip-hop and pop but not acoustic or classical
Max volume is too low for group settings
No app or EQ customization

products.name: Marshall Emberton Portable Bluetooth Speaker
products.blurb: Key specs: IP67 dust and water resistance, True Stereophonic 360-degree sound, Two full-range drivers plus two passive radiators.
strengths: Two drivers and two passive radiators produce more detail and stereo imaging than any speaker at this price
20-plus hours of battery outlasts the JBL Flip 6
Distinctive retro design and build quality feel premium relative to price
Sound quality approaches speakers costing considerably more
limitations: Larger and less compact than the JBL Flip 6, harder to clip to a bag
Regularly sells near the top of this budget range, less of a bargain than the Soundcore 3
No JBL-style multi-speaker ecosystem for large group pairing
features: Two full-range drivers plus two passive radiators
Signature woven fabric and knurled control knob

products.name: Tribit XSound Go Bluetooth Speaker
products.blurb: Key specs: IPX7 water resistance, 24-hour battery life, XBass technology.
strengths: 24-hour battery matches speakers costing twice as much
XBass mode adds real low-end without the muddiness some budget EQ boosts introduce
At around 30 dollars, one of the least expensive speakers with genuinely clean mids
IPX7 covers rain and splashes reliably despite the low price
limitations: IPX7 only, no dust rating for beach or trail use
Plastic housing feels noticeably cheaper than the Emberton or Flip 6
Max volume is adequate for one room but not outdoor gatherings

products.name: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 3 Bluetooth Speaker
products.blurb: Key specs: IP67 dust and water resistance, Floats on water, 360-degree sound.
strengths: Floats instead of sinking if dropped in a pool or lake, unlike most speakers on this list
360-degree sound means no dead spot no matter which side faces the listener
IP67 rating handles dust and full submersion
Barrel shape and rubberized shell survive drops onto concrete
limitations: Bright, bass-light tuning suits podcasts and acoustic music more than bass-heavy genres
14-hour battery trails the Soundcore 3 and Motion Boom's 24 hours
No aux input, Bluetooth only

products.name: JBL Clip 4 Portable Bluetooth Speaker
products.blurb: Key specs: IP67 dust and water resistance, Integrated carabiner clip, 10-hour battery life.
strengths: Integrated carabiner clip is genuinely secure, unlike clip-on cases bolted to other speakers
IP67 rating matches speakers twice its size
10-hour battery is respectable for a speaker this small
limitations: Small single driver limits bass and overall loudness
Not loud enough for anything beyond close-range or one-on-one listening
No multi-speaker pairing

products.name: OontZ Angle 3 Ultra Bluetooth Speaker
products.blurb: Key specs: IPX5 water resistance, Angled driver design, 14-hour battery life.
strengths: Angled drivers point sound at the listener instead of dispersing it upward
At around 25 dollars, the cheapest speaker on this list with genuinely usable volume
10-watt driver gets louder than most speakers under 30 dollars
limitations: IPX5 splash resistance only, not rated for submersion like the IP67 speakers here
Bulkier, boxier design than the cylinder or pocket-style competitors
Sound is functional rather than detailed, no standout clarity or bass depth

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
